signin.kicker: Members only · ask at the counter
signin.title: What’ll it be?
signin.lead: Use the passkey on this device, or your username and password.
signin.leadSso: Use {name}, the passkey on this device, or your username and password.
signin.leadSsoOnly: Sign in with {name} — the same login you use elsewhere.
signin.passwordSet: Password saved. Sign in with it.

errors.inviteRequired: That address has not been invited. Pretty Please Print is invite-only — ask whoever owns the printer for a link.
errors.invalidToken: That link is no longer valid. Ask the printer owner for a fresh one.
errors.tokenExpired: That link expired. Ask the printer owner for another.
errors.suspended: That account has been suspended. Ask whoever owns the printer.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your sign-on provider has not confirmed your email address, so it cannot vouch for who you are here. Verify it there, then try again.
errors.emailNotFound: Your sign-on provider did not share an email address, so there is no way to tell who you are here.
errors.providerUnverified: Your sign-on provider’s answer could not be verified, so nobody was signed in. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell whoever owns the printer.
errors.other: That sign-in attempt did not go through.

form.refused: That username and password do not match. Try again.
form.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
form.passkeyRefused: That passkey was not accepted. Use your password instead.
form.inviteOnly: Pretty Please Print is invite-only — there is no sign-up. If you have not been invited yet, or you have forgotten your password, ask whoever owns the printer.
form.inviteOnlySso: Pretty Please Print is invite-only. If signing in tells you that you have not been invited, ask whoever owns the printer.

sso.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
sso.couldNotStart: Single sign-on could not be started. Try again, or ask whoever owns the printer.

account.passkeys: {count, plural, one {# passkey on this account} other {# passkeys on this account}}
account.docsHint: Every endpoint, and a console to call them from.

nudge.title: Tired of typing your password?
nudge.body: Save a passkey and this device signs you in with a fingerprint — nothing to remember, nothing to phish.

invite.leadLocal: Pick a name to go by, a username and a password, and you are in.
invite.leadSso: Sign in with {name} and you are in.
invite.ssoFor: This invitation is for {email}. Sign in there with that address and there is no password to choose here.

reauth.lead: You are about to change who can get in. A password or a passkey confirms it is you at the keyboard and not a browser somebody left open.
reauth.leadSso: You are about to change who can get in. Signing in with {name} again confirms it is you at the keyboard and not a browser somebody left open.
reauth.ssoNotConfirmed: Signing in again with {name} did not confirm it is you: it has to ask you to sign in there again, just now. Try again, or use a passkey or your password if you have one.

ssoOnly.title: No passwords here
ssoOnly.lead: This instance signs people in with {name} only, so there is no password to choose. Sign in with the address you were invited as.

passwordsOff.refused: Passwords are switched off on this instance, so there is none to set or reset.
